title: StarRocks topology --watch: tablets sharded across 3 BE, replicated x3
description: The nexus-cli topology --watch verb for StarRocks: the tablet distribution that proves the table is sharded (DISTRIBUTED BY HASH BUCKETS across all 3 BE) AND replicated (replication_num=3).

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql --skip-ssl -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -e 'SHOW CREATE TABLE nexus.events\G'"

observe.what: DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(event_id) BUCKETS 6 + "replication_num" = "3" -- sharded + replicated by design

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.31 "mysql --skip-ssl -h 127.0.0.1 -P 9030 -u root -p$SR_ROOT_PW -e 'ADMIN SHOW REPLICA DISTRIBUTION FROM nexus.events'"

observe.what: replica counts spread across all 3 BackendIds -- tablets + their 3 replicas distributed across all 3 BE (what topology --watch renders)

whatProves: topology --watch shows tablets hash-distributed across all 3 BE with replication_num=3 -- the genuinely sharded AND replicated layout (ADR-0030).
